title.en: Europe agrees a budget whose payments exceed its new promises
title.zh: 欧洲达成预算协议：付款额为何超过新承诺

summary.en: The provisional 2027 deal separates commitments from payments on current and earlier obligations; formal approval and delivery still lie ahead.
summary.zh: 2027年临时预算协议区分承诺与当年及往年义务的付款；正式批准及执行仍在后续。

title.en: A molecular weave captures benzene, while the factory question remains
title.zh: 分子织物捕获苯，工厂里的答案仍待验证

summary.en: UT Austin explains a published selective-capture material; its reported test and reusable architecture offer promise while full-process economics remain open.
summary.zh: 得州大学奥斯汀分校介绍已发表的选择性捕获材料；实验与可重复使用的结构带来可能，完整工艺的经济性仍待验证。
